title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — FilterDirect Points on the Member Premium Percentage
content:
A member who keeps a FilterDirect subscription earns points on the member premium percentage of an after-hours call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The record read is the member's subscription under FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions: whether it is in active status, and the MERV rating of the grade shipped.

**Rule.** A member with an active FilterDirect subscription of MERV 13 or higher adds 5 points to the member premium percentage. One with an active FilterDirect subscription below MERV 13 adds 3 points. A customer without an active subscription adds nothing. The points are added to the member premium percentage before the 100 percent ceiling is applied.

| Active FilterDirect subscription | Points added |
|---|---|
| MERV 13 or higher | 5 |
| Below MERV 13 | 3 |
| None active (paused, cancelled, pending or never held) | None |

## Boundary

MERV 13 adds 5 points and MERV 11 adds 3. A MERV 16 subscription that is paused adds nothing.
